tasks.notes: Validated the existing auth silent-failure recovery implementation already present in the working tree. Interactive re-auth fallback, plugin-friendly re-auth messaging, and per-environment tenant handling all map to the selected task and pass both targeted auth and full solution tests.

tasks.title: Add FO persisted-value readback checks
tasks.notes: Added FO persisted-value readback verification after create and after each PATCH, with dedicated readback log phases and mismatch failures. Added targeted integration tests for matching readback plus create/patch mismatch cases.
acceptance: FO create path performs a readback of the created record
FO patch path performs a readback confirming the intended field transition persisted
Failures distinguish transport success from persistence mismatch

tasks.title: Add deterministic CE record correlation
tasks.notes: Replaced CE count-delta verification with deterministic per-leg CE correlation descriptors, exact correlated-row polling, duplicate/missing/unrelated guards, and patch-time same-row identity enforcement. Added targeted integration coverage for timeout (missing row), duplicate row match, unrelated row, and update row-identity drift.
acceptance: Testify queries CE by a deterministic correlation key for each exercised map leg
Create verification fails if the correlated CE row is missing, duplicated, or unrelated to the FO test record
Update verification reuses the same correlated CE row instead of accepting any CE count delta

tasks.title: Implement CE field reconciliation assertions
tasks.notes: Implemented CE correlated-row field reconciliation assertions with per-phase expected/actual checks (create + patch), added value-map output parsing for enum transform validation, surfaced per-field pass/fail in Testify result rows/UI, and added targeted tests for create/patch assertions, scalar normalization, and assertion reporting.
acceptance: Testify reads CE column values for the correlated row after create and patch operations
Result rows surface pass or fail per verified mapped field instead of count-only success
Enum and supported scalar target values are validated against expected CE outcomes

tasks.title: Block Testify maps with no assertable CE coverage
tasks.notes: Blocked Testify maps that produce runnable CE legs but zero assertable CE field plans, surfaced skipped-assertion reasons in preflight detail, and prevented completed runs from reporting valid 0/0 CE assertion results. Added targeted regression coverage and the canonical Testify validator passed.
acceptance: Preflight blocks a map when no CE field assertions can be generated for its runnable AX->CRM legs
Run execution cannot report a valid map with zero CE assertions evaluated
Blocking or status detail explains why CE assertions were unavailable for the map

tasks.title: Support temporal CE assertion normalization
tasks.notes: The planner already synthesizes `Edm.Date` and `Edm.DateTimeOffset` create values, but direct CE assertion support currently stops at string, bool, numeric, and guid types. This leaves common date-bearing dual-write fields outside the CE reconciliation surface and will become a visible blocker once T10 requires assertable coverage.
acceptance: Direct CE assertions support FO source fields typed as `Edm.Date` and `Edm.DateTimeOffset`
Expected and actual temporal values are normalized so equivalent FO and Dataverse formats compare successfully
Targeted tests cover temporal assertion pass and mismatch cases across create or patch verification

tasks.title: Surface Testify warning detail for skipped assertions
tasks.notes: The current preflight row only says `Ready (with warnings)` while `TestifyMapPlan.Warnings` contains the actual reasons assertions were skipped or learned config was applied. Operators need the warning detail in the durable UI surfaces so blocked or partial coverage is diagnosable without inspecting logs or code.
acceptance: Preflight rows expose per-map warning detail from `TestifyMapPlan.Warnings`
Execution results preserve warning detail alongside CE assertion summaries for completed maps
Tests cover warning-detail row models and any added DualWriteMapBrowser bindings
